
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/gocodinginmyway/p/22502421" title="发布于 2026-08-16 08:10">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DeepSeek Harness 开始</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>DeepSeek Harness（dsh）是由 <a href="https://deepseek.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">DeepSeek AI</a> 开发的开源 agent harness（智能体框架）。</p>
<p>它采用一切皆插件的架构，并由 <a href="https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Cordis</a> 驱动，其设计参见论文 <a href="https://github.com/cordiverse/paper" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability</a>。</p>
<ul>
<li>代码: <a href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness</a></li>
<li>文档: <a href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/README.zh.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/README.zh.md</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="准备">准备</h2>
<p>安装 Node,</p>
<ul>
<li>打开 <a href="https://nodejs.org/en/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://nodejs.org/en/download</a></li>
<li>选择 for 你的系统 using nvm with pnpm</li>
<li>依照指导安装，验证版本通过</li>
</ul>
<p>安装 Git,</p>
<ul>
<li>打开 <a href="https://git-scm.com/install" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://git-scm.com/install</a></li>
<li>选择你的系统，依照指导安装</li>
</ul>
<p>获取 DeepSeek API key，</p>
<ul>
<li>打开 <a href="https://platform.deepseek.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://platform.deepseek.com</a></li>
<li>注册，再创建 API Key，复制留存</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="运行">运行</h2>
<p>从仓库源码运行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness

# 配置 DeepSeek API key: 由启动环境提供，或之后 UI 配置
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-your-key-here

pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
</code></pre>
<h2 id="入门">入门</h2>
<p>dsh 入门: <a href="https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/quickstart" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/quickstart</a></p>
<p>按指导配置模型、选择工作区、运行任务。提示示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-txt">读 idea 文档，理解愿景、坚持原则。先梳理要设计的条目，及其组织、优先级等。
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>目前 DeepSeek API 价格已采用峰谷定价，长时任务可考虑空闲时段运行。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="脚本">脚本</h2>
<p>DeepSeek Harness 提供了 Python SDK，可以用 Python 来驱动和编排 Agent 执行复杂任务，而不仅仅依赖 Web 界面或命令行。一般用于脚本自动化、或集成到现有工作流中。</p>
<p>Python SDK: <a href="https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/python-sdk" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/python-sdk</a></p>
<h2 id="开发">开发</h2>
<p>DeepSeek Harness 本身就是一个“调度中心”，它的核心设计原则是“一切皆插件”。</p>
<p>因此需要借助 AI，尤其是 Harness 自身或其他 AI 编程工具，来完成插件开发。这是官方和社区推荐的可行路径。</p>
<ul>
<li>dsh 开发指南: <a href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/development.zh.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/development.zh.md</a></li>
<li>dsh 架构指南: <a href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/architecture.zh.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/architecture.zh.md</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="示例">示例</h2>
<p>以“AI 视频生产”为例，其 Harness 协同架构如下：</p>
<p><img alt="harness_demo_arch" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2049757/202608/2049757-20260816080816847-1754320899.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>这些 Agent 本身并未内置，都要开发相应的 dsh 插件。</p>
<p>Harness 作为总导演、制片中心，调度完成所有 Agent 的数据流转：</p>
<p><img alt="harness_demo_flow" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2049757/202608/2049757-20260816080853106-700323210.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>最终，用户给 Harness 提交需求，由它自主分析选择不同方式来调度生产视频：</p>
<p><img alt="harness_demo_decide" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2049757/202608/2049757-20260816080836314-2116045054.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="插件">插件</h2>
<p>那开发第一个插件: <a href="https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/</a></p>
<p>必然是 dsh 开始的下一步了。</p>
<p>有了自己的 idea，就立即动手开始做 Agent 插件吧。</p>
<h2 id="结语">结语</h2>
<p>Let's Go Coding ~</p>
